notes_for_editor: Thin record. NHLR is the only tower-specific source. The Forest Lookouts Aimwell page has a header only (Marengo County, Alabama Forestry Commission) and no body text. Kaufmann's 1819 News column is general, cited only for the MC-39 and climbing context, not for Aimwell's condition. NHLR gives a 100' Aermotor without naming a model, so the MC-39 point is not applied to Aimwell. Brief record matched: 1951 built and 2010 registration. height_m 30.5 converts 100 ft. Staffing, fires, access and current condition are left out because no source supports them. The only evidence that the tower still stands is NHLR's 'only one remaining' wording; no visit date is given. No photos added.
